review_notes: I read the whole file. It introduces no new definitions, structures or classes. It has only helper theorems and one large theorem. At most they duplicate lemmas, not a concept. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. I ran one grep of Mathlib for ring-equivalence transfer lemmas for HenselianLocalRing and DVR and found no competing definition. I found no competing representation of a concept, so there is no justified finding. I did not check every helper against all of Mathlib, but none of them would count as a concept duplicate under this rubric.
